body: {"better": "B", "reason": "Card A uses 'లైబ్రరీ' in English letters which violates the 'no other English words' rule, and says 'పుస్తకాలు చదవొచ్చు' which invents an activity not in the details. Card B correctly says 'చిన్న లైబ్రరీ ఉంది' using Telugu script, gives one reason ('మీకు నచ్చుతుంది'), and sticks to what the details support."}
